notes.title: Game updates regarding free-to-play
notes.content:
[b]Amateur Division[/b]
[list]
[*] Up until now, unlimited Amateur Division has only been available to Steam created accounts. We're now shipping an update so that all users, including linked accounts, can replay Amateur Divison as many times as they like! 
Note: for paying users (Steam Pass or web Yearly Unlimited/Elite/"Old Pro" subscribers), the Amateur Division is only accessible if you haven't already entered the main competition (which replaces the need for Free Amateur Division)
[*] We've fixed a bug that caused legacy "Old Pro" Yearly subscribers to not have full access to the game
[/list]

[b]TL;DR: [/b]
[list]
[*] All users can now play Solo, and unranked Team Duels, in an unlimited fashion!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/30f5f88ff0ed6d5bff0e7f40f791292cb46bb068.png[/img]

notes.title: GeoGuessr Steam Edition is now LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/fe6e07de78b1a1c71624aa7e246949b4654c2844.png[/img]

Start your [b]GeoGuessr Steam Edition [/b]([i]Early Access[/i]) journey by either creating a new account, or if you already have a GeoGuessr browser account, link it to sync your account and progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/654900c5845d26fb68fe2e5cea7482db59d445b4.png[/img]

[b]The free offering includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlimited access to Amateur Division
[*] Unlimited access to unranked Team Duels
[/list]
To unlock the [b]full Solo Duels experience[/b], you’ll need to purchase a [b]GeoGuessr Steam Pass[/b] inside the game, or be on an [b]Elite Yearly[/b] subscription.

[b]General notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Having a GeoGuessr browser subscription does not grant you full access to the GeoGuessr Steam Edition, unless you have an [b]Elite Yearly[/b] subscription. Nor does a GeoGuessr Steam Pass grant you access to the GeoGuessr browser version.
[*] GeoGuessr Steam Pass holders will be able to cross-play against GeoGuessr browser subscribers and vice versa.
[*] The game is released as [b]Early Access[/b], meaning we're continuously developing it and addressing whatever issues might arise. Bear with us!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/6cc2662d0c7a3608419c5c8bc20df4f5d3fff545.png[/img]

notes.title: Update: Release coming in May!
notes.content:
Roughly a month ago, we announced the news that [b]GeoGuessr: Steam Edition[/b] was coming to, well, Steam! Along with the annoucement, we shared a bit of information as to what the edition was to include.

Based on your feedback, we realized that we needed to ensure a convenient way to link existing GeoGuessr browser accounts to Steam. To accommodate, the release date had to be pushed slightly, which is why we're writing this to let you know that instead of April, the game will be released in [b]May[/b]. We'll keep you posted as soon as we have set a specific release date, stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/654900c5845d26fb68fe2e5cea7482db59d445b4.png[/img]

[b]Recap[/b]:
[list]
[*] This edition focuses on Competitive Solo Duels as its main game mode
[*] The game comes with a Steam exlusive, free-to-play Amateur Division
[*] Unlimited Unranked Team Duels with Steam friends
[*] Subscribers on an Elite Yearly (browser) subscription will get full access
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/6cc2662d0c7a3608419c5c8bc20df4f5d3fff545.png[/img]
